title: Inventory and harden legacy Feedly Cloud Run services
description: Booktracker has multiple public Feedly variants (feedly-fulcro, private-feedly-fulcro, and feedly-fulcro-exe) running as the project default Compute Engine identity with broad Editor/admin roles. Map each live service to this source/deploy target, inspect whether its Datomic/database component is fully ready before port bind, retain only intentional variants, limit ingress, and assign dedicated least-privilege service accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Every live Feedly variant has an owner/source mapping and cold-start readiness result; obsolete variants are removed; retained services have justified ingress and dedicated minimal identities; deployment automation matches live names/regions.
